question: Should OpenClaw add public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId fields for spawned sessions, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or bridge existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but it creates durable session-store fields and Gateway/tool API semantics that must remain stable for clients and future lineage work.

options.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while deferring traversal APIs.

options.title: Align With Resolver Lineage First
options.body: Keep this open until sessions.resolve and session-family lineage semantics are settled, then align spawned-session chain metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject Durable Root/Trace Fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and limit future work to tooling or docs if maintainers do not want a new persisted chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Spawn-Chain Contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth metadata for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests while deferring traversal APIs.
